description.en: Configure which models pstack uses per role and at what reasoning budget. Detects your available models and writes an always-applied rule that overrides the skill defaults. Use for /setup-pstack, "configure pstack models", "pstack budget", or changing pstack's model choices.
description.zh: 设置 pstack 每个角色用哪个模型、用多大的推理预算。它会查出你能用的模型，写一条始终生效的规则，覆盖技能的默认设置。用于 /setup-pstack、「configure pstack models」、「pstack budget」，或者想改 pstack 的模型选择时。

blocks.en: # Setup pstack
blocks.zh: # Setup pstack（设置 pstack）

blocks.en: Write pstack's model settings, one model per role:
blocks.zh: 写入 pstack 的模型设置，每个角色一个模型：

blocks.en:
- **Cursor:** `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc`, an always-applied rule.
- **Claude Code:** `~/.claude/rules/pstack-models.md`. Claude Code loads every file in `~/.claude/rules/` into each new session.
- **Every other harness** (Codex, Pi, OpenCode, and others): `~/.agents/pstack-models.md`. These harnesses don't load it on their own, so pstack skills read this file when they pick a model.
blocks.zh:
- **Cursor：** `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc`，一条始终生效的规则。
- **Claude Code：** `~/.claude/rules/pstack-models.md`。Claude Code 会把 `~/.claude/rules/` 里的每个文件都载入每个新会话。
- **其他所有工具**（Codex、Pi、OpenCode 等）：`~/.agents/pstack-models.md`。这些工具不会自己载入它，所以 pstack 的技能在挑模型时会读这个文件。

blocks.en: "The settings file" below means the file for your harness. In Claude Code, if that file is missing, read `~/.agents/pstack-models.md` instead, where older versions of this skill wrote it.
blocks.zh: 下文说的「设置文件」，指的是你所用工具对应的那个文件。在 Claude Code 里，如果那个文件不存在，就改读 `~/.agents/pstack-models.md`，这个技能的旧版本把设置写在那里。

blocks.en: ## Steps
blocks.zh: ## 步骤

blocks.en: ### 1. Detect available models
blocks.zh: ### 1. 查出能用的模型

blocks.en: Enumerate the model slugs you can pass to a subagent in this session (Cursor `Task`, Claude Code `Agent`, OpenCode `task`, Codex `spawn_agent`). That is the dependable source. If your harness also has a command that lists the user's models, prefer it for completeness (for example `opencode models` or `pi --list-models`). If you cannot detect any, ask the user to paste the slugs they have access to. Never write a real slug you have not confirmed is available. The aliases `inherit-parent` and `auto` are always valid even though they are not detected slugs.
blocks.zh: 列出这次会话里你能传给帮手 AI 的模型名（slug），也就是 Cursor 的 `Task`、Claude Code 的 `Agent`、OpenCode 的 `task`、Codex 的 `spawn_agent` 能接受的那些。这是靠得住的来源。如果你所用的工具还有一条能列出用户模型的命令，为了列全，优先用它（比如 `opencode models` 或 `pi --list-models`）。如果一个都查不到，就请用户把自己能用的模型名贴过来。没确认能用的真实模型名，绝不写进去。别名 `inherit-parent` 和 `auto` 永远有效，尽管它们不是查出来的模型名。

blocks.en: ### 2. Load current state
blocks.zh: ### 2. 读取当前状态

blocks.en: The default role-to-model mapping is the rule shape shown in step 5 below. If the settings file already exists, read it and treat its `# budget` line and its role values as the current choices. Otherwise start from those defaults. A line whose role is not in step 5, such as `hardest tasks`, `architect runners`, `reflect tooling`, or `why investigators`, is from a retired role. Drop it.
blocks.zh: 默认的角色和模型对应关系，就是下面第 5 步给出的规则格式。如果设置文件已经存在，就读它，把它的 `# budget` 那一行和各角色的值当作当前的选择。否则就从这些默认值开始。如果某一行的角色不在第 5 步里，比如 `hardest tasks`、`architect runners`、`reflect tooling` 或 `why investigators`，那是已经撤掉的角色，删掉这一行。

blocks.en: Older defaults put another Gemini model, then `gemini-4-neon-high`, in the panel seat. So in any settings file, a `gemini-4-neon-high` entry, or a `gemini-4-*` entry other than `gemini-4-neon-*`, in a panel role (`arena runners`, `arena cross-judge pool`, `interrogate reviewers`) is an old default. Each one becomes `gemini-4-neon-xhigh`. A Gemini 4 Neon entry at any other level is the user's choice and stays. Tell the user which entries you replaced.
blocks.zh: 旧版的默认值在小组席位上放过另一个 Gemini 模型，后来又放过 `gemini-4-neon-high`。所以不管哪个设置文件，小组角色（`arena runners`、`arena cross-judge pool`、`interrogate reviewers`）里的 `gemini-4-neon-high`，或者不是 `gemini-4-neon-*` 的 `gemini-4-*` 项，都是旧默认值，每一个都换成 `gemini-4-neon-xhigh`。其他等级的 Gemini 4 Neon 项是用户自己选的，保留不动。告诉用户你换掉了哪几项。

blocks.en: A settings file without the `# defaults: 3` line comes from an older setup. That setup wrote a line for every role, so some of its values are old defaults, not choices. Before step 3, replace these values:
blocks.zh: 没有 `# defaults: 3` 那一行的设置文件，来自旧版的设置。旧版给每个角色都写了一行，所以其中有些值是旧的默认值，不是用户的选择。在第 3 步之前，把下面这些值换掉：

blocks.en:
- An `arena cross-judge pool` list of exactly one `claude-fable-*` entry, one `claude-opus-*` entry, and one `gemini-*` entry, in any order, takes the role's step 5 list. Fable and Opus are one vendor, so the Fable entry could judge only where the Opus entry also could.
- A `# budget: unlimited` line becomes `large`, because no role runs above `xhigh`.
- If the settings file has no `# defaults: 2` line either, an old slug is one that matches `grok-*`. An old slug in `feature, refactoring`, `bug-fix`, `perf-issue`, `hillclimb`, or `swarm workers` takes the role's step 5 default. In a panel role (`arena runners`, `arena cross-judge pool`, `interrogate reviewers`), a list of exactly one `claude-opus-*` entry and one old slug, in either order, takes the role's step 5 list. In any other list, each old slug becomes `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`.
blocks.zh:
- `arena cross-judge pool` 的列表如果正好是一个 `claude-fable-*` 项、一个 `claude-opus-*` 项和一个 `gemini-*` 项，顺序不限，就换成第 5 步里这个角色的列表。Fable 和 Opus 出自同一家公司，所以 Opus 项不能当评审的地方，Fable 项也不能当。
- `# budget: unlimited` 这一行改成 `large`，因为没有哪个角色的强度高于 `xhigh`。
- 如果设置文件里连 `# defaults: 2` 那一行也没有，旧模型名就是匹配 `grok-*` 的模型名。`feature, refactoring`、`bug-fix`、`perf-issue`、`hillclimb` 或 `swarm workers` 里的旧模型名，换成第 5 步里这个角色的默认值。在小组角色（`arena runners`、`arena cross-judge pool`、`interrogate reviewers`）里，列表如果正好是一个 `claude-opus-*` 项和一个旧模型名，顺序不限，就换成第 5 步里这个角色的列表。在其他任何列表里，每个旧模型名都改成 `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`。

blocks.en: Every other value is the user's choice and stays, including an old slug in any other role and every `inherit-parent` or `auto` value. Tell the user which values you replaced.
blocks.zh: 其他每个值都是用户的选择，保留不动，包括其他角色里的旧模型名，以及每一个 `inherit-parent` 或 `auto` 值。告诉用户你换掉了哪些值。

blocks.en: ### 3. Budget, map, and confirm
blocks.zh: ### 3. 定预算、对应模型、确认

blocks.en: **(a) Ask for a budget.** Prefer your structured-question tool (`AskQuestion` in Cursor, `AskUserQuestion` in Claude Code, `question` in OpenCode) over free text. Offer these three options with these exact labels, and name the current budget when the rule records one. With no rule, say that `large` matches the skill defaults.
blocks.zh: **(a) 问预算。** 优先用你的结构化提问工具（Cursor 里的 `AskQuestion`、Claude Code 里的 `AskUserQuestion`、OpenCode 里的 `question`），不要用自由文本。给出下面这三个选项，标签要和这里逐字一样；如果规则里记着当前预算，就说出来。如果没有规则，就说明 `large` 和技能的默认设置一致。

blocks.en:
- `large — xhigh reasoning`
- `medium — high reasoning`
- `small — medium reasoning`
blocks.zh:
- `large — xhigh reasoning`
- `medium — high reasoning`
- `small — medium reasoning`

blocks.en: **(b) Apply it.** Build the working table from the skill defaults, and on a re-run keep any role you changed by family, list, or alias (`inherit-parent`, `auto`). Families are the ones Phase A of the **arena** skill defines, so Fable is its own family. Each role has a target effort, which is its default's effort moved by the budget. `large` keeps it, `medium` lowers it one step, and `small` lowers it two steps, on the ladder `xhigh` > `high` > `medium` > `low`. No role runs above `xhigh`, and a target at the bottom of the ladder stays there. Most defaults are at `xhigh`, and each budget label names where those land. Set the effort token of every real slug in the role, panel entries included, to the role's target. The effort token is the last token, or the one before a trailing `fast`. If the result is not a detected slug, use the same family's detected slug with the highest effort at or below the target, else mark the role as needing a choice. `inherit-parent` and `auto` do not change. So `medium` turns `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast` into `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast` and `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast` into `claude-opus-5-5-medium-fast`, and `small` turns them into `claude-opus-5-5-medium-fast` and `claude-opus-5-5-low-fast`. Opus 5.5 always runs its `-fast` slug, so every Opus 5.5 value ends in `-fast`. Fable 5.2 and Gemini have no fast slug, so never write one. Gemini 4 Neon slugs run from `low` to `xhigh` with no `max` or `fast` slug, so its seat runs at `gemini-4-neon-xhigh`, its top slug. A Gemini 4 Neon entry in a panel role takes its own target, `xhigh` moved by the budget, so `large` keeps `gemini-4-neon-xhigh`, `medium` writes `gemini-4-neon-high`, and `small` writes `gemini-4-neon-medium`.
blocks.zh: **(b) 套用预算。** 从技能的默认设置建一张工作表；如果是重跑，保留你按系列、列表或别名（`inherit-parent`、`auto`）改过的角色。系列就是 **arena** 技能阶段 A 里定义的那些，所以 Fable 自成一个系列。每个角色都有一个目标强度，就是它默认值的强度按预算挪过之后的结果。`large` 保持不变，`medium` 降一档，`small` 降两档，强度从高到低是 `xhigh` > `high` > `medium` > `low`。没有哪个角色的强度高于 `xhigh`；目标已经在最低一档的，就停在那里。大多数默认值在 `xhigh`，每个预算标签写的就是它们降到哪一档。把这个角色里每个真实模型名（包括小组列表里的条目）的强度标记设为这个角色的目标强度。强度标记是模型名的最后一段；如果最后一段是 `fast`，就是它前面那一段。如果结果不是查出来的模型名，就用同一系列里、强度不超过目标的最高那个已查出的模型名；没有的话，就把这个角色标成需要选择。`inherit-parent` 和 `auto` 不变。所以 `medium` 会把 `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast` 变成 `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`，把 `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast` 变成 `claude-opus-5-5-medium-fast`；`small` 会把它们变成 `claude-opus-5-5-medium-fast` 和 `claude-opus-5-5-low-fast`。Opus 5.5 总是用它的 `-fast` 模型名跑，所以每个 Opus 5.5 的值都以 `-fast` 结尾。Fable 5.2 和 Gemini 没有 fast 模型名，所以绝不要写。Gemini 4 Neon 的模型名从 `low` 到 `xhigh`，没有 `max` 也没有 `fast`，所以它的席位用最高的 `gemini-4-neon-xhigh`。小组角色里的 Gemini 4 Neon 项有自己的目标强度，就是 `xhigh` 按预算挪过之后的结果：`large` 保持 `gemini-4-neon-xhigh`，`medium` 写 `gemini-4-neon-high`，`small` 写 `gemini-4-neon-medium`。

blocks.en: **(c) Show the roles and confirm.** Show every role with its model, marking any real slug not in the detected set as needing a choice. Also list each line step 2 dropped. Ask whether to accept as-is or change specific roles, offering the detected models at `xhigh` or below plus `inherit-parent` and `auto` (both mean: this role runs on the parent chat model, which is how Auto users stay on Auto) as the options. Prefer your structured-question tool over free text. For panel roles (arena runners, interrogate reviewers) the value is a list, and one subagent runs per entry, alias entries included, so the list length sets the count. `arena cross-judge pool` is also a list, but Arena runs one judge. It tries only values from a vendor other than the parent's, in list order, so order it by preference. Fable and the other Claude models are one vendor. An `inherit-parent` or `auto` value never judges. `swarm workers` is the default model for every worker unless a race or comparison assigns another model per arm.
blocks.zh: **(c) 列出角色并确认。** 列出每个角色和它的模型，凡是不在已查出集合里的真实模型名，都标成需要选择。第 2 步删掉的每一行也列出来。问用户是照单全收，还是改某几个角色；选项是查出来的、强度在 `xhigh` 或以下的模型，再加上 `inherit-parent` 和 `auto`（两者都表示：这个角色用主对话的模型跑，用 Auto 的用户就是靠这个一直留在 Auto 上）。优先用你的结构化提问工具，不要用自由文本。小组角色（arena runners、interrogate reviewers）的值是一个列表，每个条目跑一个帮手 AI，别名条目也算，所以列表有多长，就跑几个。`arena cross-judge pool` 也是一个列表，但 Arena 只跑一个评委。它只试和主对话模型出自不同公司的值，按列表顺序试，所以要按你的偏好排序。Fable 和其他 Claude 模型算同一家。值为 `inherit-parent` 或 `auto` 的条目永远不当评委。`swarm workers` 是每个干活帮手的默认模型，除非竞速或比较时给每一路另外指定了模型。

blocks.en: ### 4. Validate
Every real slug written must be in the detected set and at `xhigh` or below. `inherit-parent` and `auto` always pass. If a chosen real slug is not available, stop and ask again.
blocks.zh: 写进去的每个真实模型名都必须在已查出的集合里，而且强度在 `xhigh` 或以下。`inherit-parent` 和 `auto` 永远通过。如果选中的某个真实模型名用不了，就停下来重新问。

blocks.en: ### 5. Write the rule

Write the settings file with the `# defaults: 3` line, a `# budget` line with the chosen label and the effort that label names, and one line per role, using the same labels poteto-mode uses. In Cursor, include the frontmatter below with `alwaysApply: true`. In other harnesses, write the settings file without the frontmatter (start at the first `#` line). Overwrite the whole file so re-runs stay idempotent. Shape:
blocks.zh: 写设置文件：一行 `# defaults: 3`；一行 `# budget`，写上选定的标签和这个标签写的强度；每个角色一行，用和 poteto-mode 相同的标签。在 Cursor 里，带上下面的 frontmatter，其中写 `alwaysApply: true`。在其他工具里，写设置文件时不带 frontmatter（从第一个 `#` 行开始）。整个文件覆盖重写，这样重跑多少次结果都一样。格式：

blocks.en:
```
---
description: pstack per-role model choices (overrides skill defaults)
alwaysApply: true
---
# pstack model configuration. One line per role. Delete a line to fall back to the skill default.
# `inherit-parent` or `auto` as a value: the role runs on the parent chat model (omit the subagent `model` and spawn a general-purpose subagent). Alias entries in a panel list still count toward its fan-out.
# defaults: 3
# budget: large (xhigh)
feature, refactoring: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
bug-fix: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
perf-issue: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
hillclimb: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
judgment and prose: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
arena runners: claude-fable-5-2-high, claude-opus-5-5-high-fast, gemini-4-neon-xhigh
arena cross-judge pool: claude-opus-5-5-high-fast, gemini-4-neon-xhigh
swarm workers: claude-opus-5-5-high-fast
interrogate reviewers: claude-fable-5-2-high, claude-opus-5-5-high-fast, gemini-4-neon-xhigh
```
blocks.zh:
```
---
description: pstack per-role model choices (overrides skill defaults)
alwaysApply: true
---
# pstack model configuration. One line per role. Delete a line to fall back to the skill default.
# `inherit-parent` or `auto` as a value: the role runs on the parent chat model (omit the subagent `model` and spawn a general-purpose subagent). Alias entries in a panel list still count toward its fan-out.
# defaults: 3
# budget: large (xhigh)
feature, refactoring: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
bug-fix: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
perf-issue: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
hillclimb: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
judgment and prose: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast
arena runners: claude-fable-5-2-high, claude-opus-5-5-high-fast, gemini-4-neon-xhigh
arena cross-judge pool: claude-opus-5-5-high-fast, gemini-4-neon-xhigh
swarm workers: claude-opus-5-5-high-fast
interrogate reviewers: claude-fable-5-2-high, claude-opus-5-5-high-fast, gemini-4-neon-xhigh
```

blocks.en: ### 6. Confirm

Tell the user which file was written. In Cursor and Claude Code, it applies to new sessions. In other harnesses, pstack skills read `~/.agents/pstack-models.md` when they pick a model. Re-running this skill updates it.
blocks.zh: 告诉用户写的是哪个文件。在 Cursor 和 Claude Code 里，它对新会话生效。在其他工具里，pstack 的技能挑模型时会读 `~/.agents/pstack-models.md`。重跑这个技能就会更新它。

blocks.en: ### 7. Offer a verification skill (optional)
blocks.zh: ### 7. 提议生成一个验证技能（可选）

blocks.en: Check whether the project has a way to drive the real app for proof (a `verify-*` skill, or an existing harness). If not, offer once: "want a project-local verification skill, so agents can drive the app the way a user does and prove changes work? I can generate one with /create-verification-skill." On yes, invoke `/create-verification-skill` (resolves wherever pstack is installed: workspace, user, or plugin). On no, move on without pushing.
blocks.zh: 看看项目里有没有办法驱动真实应用来拿证据（一个 `verify-*` 技能，或者现成的驱动工具）。如果没有，就提议一次：「要不要一个放在项目里的验证技能？这样 AI 就能像用户那样操作应用，证明改动有效。我可以用 /create-verification-skill 生成一个。」对方答应，就调用 `/create-verification-skill`（不管 pstack 装在哪里都能找到：工作区、用户目录或插件）。对方拒绝，就接着往下走，不要硬推。

blocks.en: ### 8. Offer a formal verification skill (optional)
blocks.zh: ### 8. 提议生成一个形式化验证技能（可选）

blocks.en: Check whether the project already has a formal verification skill (a project skill that runs a model checker, a proof, or another verifier against the code). If not, offer once: "want a formal verification skill, so agents can prove a key property of your code holds in every case in scope, not only the cases tests reach? I can generate one with /create-formal-verification-skill." On yes, invoke `/create-formal-verification-skill` (resolves wherever pstack is installed: workspace, user, or plugin). On no, move on without pushing.
blocks.zh: 看看项目里是不是已经有形式化验证技能（一个对代码运行模型检查器、证明或其他验证器的项目技能）。如果没有，就提议一次：「要不要一个形式化验证技能？这样 AI 就能证明你代码里的一条关键性质在范围内的每种情况下都成立，而不只是测试碰得到的那些情况。我可以用 /create-formal-verification-skill 生成一个。」对方答应，就调用 `/create-formal-verification-skill`（不管 pstack 装在哪里都能找到：工作区、用户目录或插件）。对方拒绝，就接着往下走，不要硬推。

lessons.quote: Never write a real slug you have not confirmed is available.
lessons.quoteZh: 没确认能用的真实模型名，绝不写进去。

zh.title: 没确认过的不许写
zh.does: 配置里只会出现你真能用的模型，不会冒出一个编出来的名字让运行失败。
zh.why: 「绝不」加上「确认」这个具体动作，比一句「要准确」难绕过得多。
zh.try: 让 AI 整理报价时写：「只列你在官网上确认过的价格，查不到的写『未确认』。」

en.title: Write only what's confirmed
en.does: Only models you can actually use end up in the settings, never a made-up name that breaks a run.
en.why: "Never" tied to a concrete step, confirming, is much harder to slip past than "be accurate".
en.try: When you ask for a price list: "List only prices you confirmed on the official site; mark the rest 'unconfirmed'."

lessons.quote: Offer these three options with these exact labels, and name the current budget when the rule records one.
lessons.quoteZh: 给出下面这三个选项，标签要和这里逐字一样；如果规则里记着当前预算，就说出来。

zh.title: 把选项一字不差写出来
zh.does: 它问预算时，每次都给你同样的三个选项，说法也一样，还会告诉你现在选的是哪一档。
zh.why: 把选项原样写进提示词并要求照抄，AI 就不会自己改写、多加一个或漏掉一个。
zh.try: 让 AI 做问卷时写：「问满意度只给三个选项：『满意』『一般』『不满意』，原样照抄。」

en.title: Spell out the exact options
en.does: It asks about budget with the same three options every time, worded the same way, and names your current one.
en.why: Writing the options into the prompt and asking for them verbatim stops the AI from rewording, adding or dropping one.
en.try: For a survey: "Ask about satisfaction with exactly these options: 'Satisfied', 'OK', 'Not satisfied'."

lessons.quote: So `medium` turns `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast` into `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast` and `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast` into `claude-opus-5-5-medium-fast`, and `small` turns them into `claude-opus-5-5-medium-fast` and `claude-opus-5-5-low-fast`.
lessons.quoteZh: 所以 `medium` 会把 `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast` 变成 `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`，把 `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast` 变成 `claude-opus-5-5-medium-fast`；`small` 会把它们变成 `claude-opus-5-5-medium-fast` 和 `claude-opus-5-5-low-fast`。

zh.title: 规则后面跟个算好的例子
zh.does: 它按预算换模型时不容易算错，比如选中档预算，就把每个模型降一档，xhigh 变成 high。
zh.why: 抽象的换算规则容易读偏，紧跟一个算好的例子，AI 能拿自己的结果对一对。
zh.try: 给换算规则时顺手举例：「金额四舍五入到百位，比如 1,260 写成 1,300。」

en.title: Follow a rule with an example
en.does: It swaps models for your budget correctly, such as dropping each model one step, xhigh to high, for the medium budget.
en.why: An abstract conversion rule is easy to misread; a worked example right after lets the AI check its own answer.
en.try: Give an example with the rule: "Round amounts to the nearest hundred, so 1,260 becomes 1,300."

lessons.quote: On no, move on without pushing.
lessons.quoteZh: 对方拒绝，就接着往下走，不要硬推。

zh.title: 只问一次，被拒就停
zh.does: 它只提一次要不要生成验证技能，你说不要，它就不再提。
zh.why: 写明问几次、被拒后怎么办，AI 就不会一遍遍推销附加功能。
zh.try: 让 AI 写文章时加一句：「结尾可以问一次要不要配图；我说不用，就别再提。」

en.title: Ask once, drop it on no
en.does: It offers a verification skill once, and drops it if you say no.
en.why: Saying how many times to ask and what to do on a no keeps the AI from pitching extras again and again.
en.try: When the AI writes for you: "You may ask once at the end whether I want images; if I say no, drop it."

compare.without: 写进一个你用不了的模型名
compare.with: 先列出这次能调用的模型，只写里面有的

compare.without: 不问你就把配置写好了
compare.with: 先问三档预算，再列出每个角色的模型，等你确认

compare.without: 重跑时留着已经废弃的角色行
compare.with: 删掉废弃的角色，整份覆盖文件，重跑结果一样

zh.intro: 开头说明配置文件放哪，Cursor、Claude Code 和其他工具各用一个路径。
sections: 一共八步，从查能用的模型，到写配置，最后是两次可选的提议。
列出这次能传给帮手 AI 的模型名，一个都查不到就请你贴上来。
已有配置就读出预算和各角色的模型，当作起点，删掉废弃角色的行，旧版留下的默认值换成新的，并告诉你换了哪些。
问你选 large、medium、small 哪一档，照档把每个角色的推理强度降零到两档（最高 xhigh），再列表让你确认或改。
写之前再核一遍，选中的模型不在能用的名单里或强度高于 xhigh，就停下重新问你。
写一行 `# defaults: 3`、一行预算，每个角色一行，整份覆盖文件，Cursor 版加上 `alwaysApply: true`。
告诉你写了哪个文件。在 Cursor 和 Claude Code 里，新开的对话才用上它。
项目里还没有能驱动 app 的验证办法，就问一次要不要用 `/create-verification-skill` 生成。
还没有形式化验证技能，就问一次要不要用 `/create-formal-verification-skill` 生成，你说不要就往下走。

compare.without: Writes a model name you can't actually use.
compare.with: Lists the models it can call this session and writes only those.

compare.without: Writes the settings without asking you.
compare.with: Asks for one of three budgets, shows each role's model, and waits for your OK.

compare.without: Leaves retired role lines in the file on a re-run.
compare.with: Drops retired roles and overwrites the whole file, so re-runs give the same result.

en.intro: It lists where the settings file goes in Cursor, Claude Code and every other harness.
sections: Eight steps, from finding usable models to writing the file, ending with two optional offers.
Lists the model names it can pass to helpers this session. If it finds none, it asks you to paste yours.
Reads an existing file's budget and role choices as the starting point, drops retired roles, and swaps old-setup defaults for new ones, saying which.
Asks for large, medium or small, lowers each role's effort zero to two steps (never above xhigh), then shows the roles to accept or change.
Checks every chosen model is in the detected list and at xhigh or below. If one isn't, it stops and asks again.
Writes a `# defaults: 3` line, a budget line and one line per role over the whole file. The Cursor version adds `alwaysApply: true`.
Tells you which file it wrote. In Cursor and Claude Code, new sessions pick it up.
If the project has no way to drive the app, it offers once to generate one with `/create-verification-skill`.
If there is no formal verification skill, it offers once to run `/create-formal-verification-skill`. On no, it moves on.
